newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Blast shakes Karachi's business district.
newsitem.headline: Blast shakes Karachi's business district.

text.p: A powerful blast outside a Pakistan International Airlines cargo office shook the business district of Karachi on Wednesday but ambulance officials said there were no immediate reports of any casualties.
A police official said a bomb exploded at around 0245 GMT (7.45 a.m.) outside the building but there were no reports of casualties as the blast happened before the offices opened.
An airline official said the blast on a road a few yards (metres) away from the cargo office had broken windows at the building but no-one was injured.
"We heard a powerful bomb explosion," said an official at a foreign bank near the cargo office.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the blast in the violence-plagued city, where more than 2,000 people were killed in 1995 in sectarian, ethnic and political violence.
